categoryDesc.work: Work for a Finnish employer. A job offer is required; sector collective agreements (TES) may set a minimum salary.

categoryDesc.permanent: Continuous residence for the required period. From 8 Jan 2026, language and employment-history conditions also apply.

aboutPage.title: About Nordway
aboutPage.lead: A premium, transparent relocation service — part of the VOON I/O network.

paragraphs: Nordway exists to make moving to the North understandable. Finnish immigration is precise and well-documented, but for someone in Türkiye facing it for the first time, the language, the categories and the income thresholds can feel like a wall.

We translate that wall into a clear, step-by-step path — in Turkish, Finnish and English — while being completely honest about what we are and are not. We are not an authority, we do not replace Migri, and we never promise an outcome we cannot control.
What we offer is clarity, coordination and fewer mistakes: the things that save you time and reduce the risk of a rejection over an avoidable paperwork error.

security.title: How we protect your data
security.lead: Immigration cases involve sensitive information. Here's exactly what stands between it and anyone who shouldn't see it.

items.title: Isolated by design
items.body: Postgres Row-Level Security enforces, at the database itself, that your account can only ever read your own case, documents and messages — not just a check in the app that could be bypassed.

items.title: Encrypted, always
items.body: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS). Uploaded documents live in a private store that is never publicly reachable.

items.title: You're in control
items.body: Download a full copy of your data or permanently delete your account at any time from your dashboard — no support ticket required.

items.title: Named processors only
items.body: We share data only with the specific processors that run the service — Supabase, Anthropic and Resend — under data-processing agreements. We never sell your data.

items.title: Consent, on record
items.body: Every consent you give is timestamped against the exact notice version, so there's always a clear answer to "what did I agree to, and when."

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Notice (Tietosuojaseloste)
legalPrivacy.intro: This notice explains how Nordway, a VOON I/O service, processes personal data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Immigration-related data is sensitive, and we treat it accordingly.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Nordway is operated by [DOLDURULACAK: legal company name, e.g. "Nordway Oy"], registered in Finland (Business ID / Y-tunnus: [DOLDURULACAK]), registered address: [DOLDURULACAK]. We are the data controller for the personal data processed through this service. Contact for all privacy matters: info@voon.fi.

sections.heading: What we collect, why, and on what legal basis
body: Identity and contact details (name, email) — to create and manage your account and to communicate with you. Legal basis: performance of a contract with you.

Case details you choose to share (permit category, target city, family situation, income range, and any free-text notes) — to assess your eligibility and prepare your case. Legal basis: your explicit consent, and performance of a contract.

Documents you upload (e.g. passport copy, employment contract, income proof, diploma, insurance certificate) — to check completeness and support your application. We do not intentionally collect health or biometric data; if a document you upload incidentally contains special-category data, we process it only for the purpose you requested, on the basis of your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR).
Technical data (IP address, device and browser information) — to keep the site secure and functioning correctly. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in security.
Billing and payment records — to invoice you and meet our accounting obligations. Legal basis: performance of a contract and legal obligation.
A record of your consent choices (what you agreed to, when, and against which notice version) — to demonstrate compliance. Legal basis: legal obligation and our legitimate interest in accountability.

sections.heading: Storage & security
body: Every account can only ever access its own data — enforced at the database level (Postgres Row-Level Security), not just in the app.
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS).
Documents are kept in a private store, never publicly reachable, accessible only via signed, time-limited links.
We apply data minimisation and role-based access, and keep an internal audit trail of sensitive actions such as account deletion.
You can download a full copy of your data or permanently delete your account at any time from your dashboard — see "Your rights" below.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your data. We share it only with the specific processors that run the service, under data-processing agreements: Supabase (database, authentication and document storage), Anthropic (AI-assisted case review — server-side only, never your login credentials or payment details), and Resend (transactional email). We never share your data with immigration authorities on your behalf without your explicit instruction.

sections.heading: International data transfers
sections.body: We do not currently transfer personal data to Türkiye, or otherwise outside the EU/EEA, in the course of providing the service — our infrastructure and case handling run from within the EU. Some processors we use (Anthropic, Resend) are based in the United States; where data is transferred to them, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or another legally recognised safeguard. [DOLDURULACAK: if Nordway later works with a Türkiye-based office, partner or representative who receives personal data, this section must be updated with the specific safeguard used for that transfer.]

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can exercise these rights any time — download or delete your data instantly from your account dashboard, or email info@voon.fi for anything else.
Access, rectify or erase your data.
Withdraw consent at any time.
Download your data (portability) — available instantly from your account settings.
Object to or restrict processing.
Lodge a complaint with the Finnish Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto) — tietosuoja.fi.

sections.heading: Retention
body: Account and case data: retained for up to 5 years after your case is closed or your account becomes inactive, to meet potential legal or liability needs — or deleted sooner if you delete your account.
Uploaded documents: retained for up to 5 years after case closure on the same basis, then deleted — or deleted sooner if you delete your account.
Billing records: kept for 6 years to meet Finnish accounting-law (kirjanpitolaki) requirements.
Consent records: kept for the lifetime of the account so we can always show what you agreed to and when.
Deleting your account (see "Your rights") is always honoured immediately — these periods are the default when you don't ask us to delete sooner.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy request, email info@voon.fi. This notice is provided for transparency and does not constitute legal advice.

legalCookies.title: Cookie Policy
legalCookies.intro: This policy explains how Nordway uses cookies and similar technologies.

sections.heading: What cookies we use
body: Strictly necessary cookies for the site to function (session, login, security, language and theme preference).

We do not currently use analytics or advertising cookies. The "Accept all" / "Essential only" choice exists so we're ready if that ever changes — if it does, we'll update this policy and ask for your consent again before anything non-essential runs.

sections.heading: Cookies we set
body: nordway_cookie_consent — strictly necessary — stores your cookie choice and the notice version it was given against — 1 year.
nordway_theme — strictly necessary (functional) — remembers your light/dark theme preference — 1 year.
NEXT_LOCALE — strictly necessary (functional) — remembers your chosen language (Turkish/Finnish/English) — 1 year.
sb-*-auth-token — strictly necessary — keeps you signed in to your account — cleared when you log out or your session expires.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can accept or decline non-essential cookies. To change your choice at any time, use the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer. Declining does not affect access to the core service.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may break parts of the site.
